name: Dying destroys everything you carry except your soul

evidence.semantics: On death every equipped item except the soul and every bag item (gold included) is deleted; nothing is dropped. The bank is untouched.

writes.note: Death drop: the `b` into the random-armour loop becomes `bl 0x080bb3b4 (delete_all); b 0x0800f54e` (vanilla slot-flag refresh + gold drop, which then finds no gold).
Death drop: the `b` into the random-armour loop becomes `bl 0x080bb3b4 (delete_all); b 0x0800fbae` (vanilla slot-flag refresh + gold drop, which then finds no gold).
Allocation 0x080bb3b4..0x080bb3e3 (48 B, was zero; owner lose_all_on_death): delete_all() zeroes owner +0x78..+0x2E7 except the soul record +0x138.
